2123208937772081371.en_summary: aeberman12 asks if U.S. energy exports have peaked. LNG exports can still grow as new terminals come online, but market-share gains will be harder against Qatar, Canada and recovering Gulf supply. US energy exports haven't necessarily peaked, but era of extraordinary growth may be ending.
2123208937772081371.zh_summary: aeberman12 詢問美國能源出口是否已達峰值。液化天然氣出口仍可隨著新終端上線而增長，但面對卡塔爾、加拿大和恢復的海灣供應，市場份額增長將更難。美國能源出口未必已達峰值，但非凡增長時代可能結束。
